classes.name: AesGcmDecryptingStream
classes.description: Implements a stream to handle AES-GCM decryption for encrypted data streams, supporting both AWS SDK and OpenSSL decryption methods, ensuring seamless streaming decryption.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the stream with encrypted data, cryptographic parameters, and configurations.

methods.description: Returns the AES GCM algorithm name.

methods.name: getCurrentIv
methods.description: Returns the current initialization vector used for decryption.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Performs the decryption operation and returns a stream containing decrypted data, using either OpenSSL or AWS SDK based on PHP version.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates whether the stream is writable (always false).
